description: Maintain an in-memory Set<string> of currently active target keys (owner/repo#number). Before starting any run, check if the target is already in-flight — if so, queue the batch instead of starting immediately. Remove from the set when the run completes or fails. Enforce a global concurrency cap (default 3, configurable via config) using a simple counter — if at cap, queue all new batches regardless of target.
title: inFlightTargets concurrency tracking and global cap
